description: Calibrate the large-seed paired instrument. Nothing changes in the scored path. In an untimed side script, run the benchmark's own trial code (benchmark/ is not edited) on seeds 3-102 for two arms, one fresh process each. Arm A is unchanged E100 code (176e5ec). Arm B is E100 plus one math-neutral perturbation that does change fp bits: in prepare, compute the normalization as x*inv_std - mean*inv_std instead of (x-mean)*inv_std, which re-draws every seed's trajectory. Log per-seed accuracy, per-seed final-weight checksums and the cuDNN conv kernel names per (layer, shape). Free by-product for H4.5.1: in the same session, cluster the kernel-name sets already logged in E094/E098/E099/E106 against their process means. Store arm A's 100-seed vector as the paired baseline for every later large-seed A/B, so H8.2.2 needs only its treatment arm. Scored row: rerun E100 unchanged, which adds a 4th distinct scored sample.
